discourse.excerpt: When you recognise the One as present in all beings and respect everyone as a manifestation of the Divine, you will achieve equality in the true sense of the term.
discourse.theme: Real equality comes not from equal things but from love that sees the One Divine in all beings.
discourse.title: Equality through Love

reflection: Swami says true equality is not the equal distribution of things, but love that recognises the One Divine present in every being. Today, greet everyone you meet — the cleaner and the chief alike — with the same warmth and respect. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18, 11 Dec 1985)
seva_nudge: Treat everyone you meet today as the same Divine — offer the same warm greeting and the same patient listening to each person, whoever they are.

video.title: Love Without Duty is Divine | Ms. Nishi with Sathya Sai
